en: A vintage sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a formally dressed man in a tuxedo with white bow tie and waistcoat, posed against a plain dark studio background. The lower margin of the image shows a small serial number and a photographer's mark, while the card's caption area below the photo bears the printed name 'Harry Liedtke'. At the very bottom left it notes the publisher and location in small print.
